request.style: English, female solo voice, piano, strings, acoustic guitar, cello, hopeful and majestic, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The voice cries out to speak
All flesh is just like grass
Its beauty fades so fast
The flower dies in the field

[Verse]
The breath of the Lord blows on it
Surely the people are grass
The word of our God stands forever
It will not fade away

[Pre-Chorus]
Go up on a high mountain
You who bring good news to Zion
Lift up your voice with strength
Do not be afraid at all

[Chorus]
Say to the cities of Judah
Here is your God
Behold there is their God
Here is your God

[Verse]
See the Lord comes with power
His arm rules for him
His reward is with him
His recompense goes before him

[Chorus]
Say to the cities of Judah
Here is your God
Behold there is their God
Here is your God

[Bridge]
He gathers the lambs in his arms
Carries them close to his heart
Gently leads the nursing ewes
He tends his flock like a shepherd

[Outro]
Here is your God
Here is your God
